seo.title: Foxhill Manor: Broadway Exclusive-Use Cotswolds Review
seo.description: 8-suite Farncombe Estate manor with no menus, no rules. Score 91/100, from $1,100/night. Best suite, 7-night plan.

content.verdict: Foxhill Manor is the most romantic small hotel in the Cotswolds and one of the very best country-house experiences in Europe — eight bedrooms in an Edwardian gabled manor on the 400-acre Farncombe Estate above Broadway, run on a deliberately house-party model with no printed menus, no formal restaurant, no check-in desk, no rules. You arrive, you're shown your suite, you tell the kitchen what you fancy for dinner, you eat it in the dining room with the other guests around a single table or alone by the fire in the snug. The chef cooks to your specification and changes course mid-week. The bar is an honesty bar — pour your own drinks, write what you took in a book. The whole property feels like staying with friends in their large country house, except the friends are exceptionally good hosts, the wine cellar is serious, and the breakfast is the best in Britain. The honeymoon proposition is the intimacy: with only eight rooms (often fully bought-out for weddings — confirm at booking), the staff-to-guest ratio is extraordinary, and the lack of structure means you genuinely set your own pace. The Farncombe Estate also includes Dormy House (more conventional 4-star country hotel with spa) and The Fish (fishing-lodge-themed boutique with shepherd's huts) — Foxhill Manor guests can use both spas, which solves the only real Foxhill weakness (no on-site spa). The position on the Cotswold escarpment above Broadway with the view across the Vale of Evesham is the best in the region. The caveats are real: this is a small property, often booked exclusively for weddings or family parties — your honeymoon window depends on availability. There's no spa on-site (you walk down the hill to Dormy House — 5 minutes by buggy). And the no-menu model requires couples who enjoy talking to the chef and other guests, not honeymooners wanting silent room-service privacy. For the right couples, Foxhill is the most romantic hotel in England. The honeymoon move is five nights, a Hilltop Suite with the Vale view, a chef's table dinner on night one, a fireside dinner for two in the library on night two, breakfast on your terrace every morning, and the long Cotswold Way walk from your front door.
content.best_room: A Hilltop Suite (Apollo or Mercury) on the south side — large rooms with full-height windows facing the Vale of Evesham, four-poster beds, freestanding baths, log fires. The Master Suite is the largest with a separate dressing room. Avoid the smaller north-facing rooms — they're lovely but lose the Foxhill view. The Garden Suite is the ground-floor pick for older couples who don't want stairs.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Arrival and chef's table
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive 90 min from London Heathrow or train Paddington to Moreton-in-Marsh (90 min) then 20 min taxi. Welcome champagne in the drawing room, chef's table dinner — tell the kitchen what you love and let them surprise you.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Cotswold Way walk and Dormy House spa
itinerary_7_nights.description: Walk from the front door along the Cotswold Way to Broadway Tower (3 miles each way). Lunch at The Lygon Arms in Broadway village. Afternoon at the Dormy House spa (5 min by buggy). Dinner for two in the library by the fire.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Chipping Campden and Hidcote Manor
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive 15 min to Chipping Campden — the most perfect Cotswolds village High Street. Hidcote Manor Gardens (one of the great Arts and Crafts gardens) for the afternoon. Lunch at The Eight Bells. Return for fireside drinks.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Daylesford Organic morning
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive 30 min to Daylesford for cookery class or spa morning. Lunch in the farm restaurant. Afternoon nap, evening drinks with other guests at the honesty bar, dinner at the chef's table.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Stratford-upon-Avon day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive 45 min to Stratford for Shakespeare's birthplace and Anne Hathaway's Cottage. Lunch at The Townhouse. Afternoon RSC matinee if running. Return for late dinner at Foxhill.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Stow and Bourton villages
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive 30 min to Stow-on-the-Wold for the Wednesday antiques fair (if your day aligns). Lunch at The Old Stocks Inn. Afternoon at Bourton-on-the-Water for the river walk. Final dinner — chef's choice tasting menu.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Slow morning
itinerary_7_nights.description: Long breakfast on the terrace, last walk along the ridge, drive to London or Moreton-in-Marsh station.

caveats: Foxhill Manor is often booked exclusively for weddings and family parties — confirm honeymoon dates well ahead and ask whether you'll be sharing with a wedding group.
There is no spa on the Foxhill property — you walk or buggy 5 minutes to Dormy House for treatments. Fine but not what some honeymoon couples expect.
The no-menu, communal-dining model requires sociability. Couples wanting silent room-service privacy should choose Lime Wood or Cowley Manor instead.

faqs.question: Good for honeymooners?
faqs.answer: Foxhill Manor is one of the most romantic hotels in Europe — the intimacy, the lack of structure, the staff ratio, the view across the Vale of Evesham. Best for couples who want a country-house-party feel rather than a luxury-hotel feel.

faqs.question: Best time to visit?
faqs.answer: May, June, and September are the prime windows — long days, full Cotswold walks open, dry weather. October for the autumn colour and fires lit. December for the Farncombe Christmas programme with carol singers and Boxing Day hunt meet.

faqs.question: Book in advance?
faqs.answer: Hilltop Suites for May-September: 6-9 months. Master Suite books out 9-12 months ahead. Wedding bookouts can lock entire weeks — check availability early.

faqs.question: Adults-only?
faqs.answer: No formally, but the no-toy, library-and-honesty-bar model means families rarely book. The guest mix skews overwhelmingly to couples and small adult parties.

faqs.question: Best room type?
faqs.answer: Hilltop Suite (Apollo or Mercury) with the Vale view and four-poster. Master Suite for the largest space. Garden Suite for ground floor. Skip the smaller north-facing rooms.

faqs.question: How to get there?
faqs.answer: London Heathrow 90 min drive, London Paddington train to Moreton-in-Marsh 90 min then 20 min taxi, or to Honeybourne 100 min then 15 min taxi. The property arranges transfers from either station and Heathrow.
